office_does: The assessor values all taxable property in San Juan County for property taxes. Nonpartisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: John Kulseth, Assessor since 2015, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County Assessor since 2015 and an appraiser in the office since 2004; the only candidate.
highlights: Wants an assessment process that is "professional, fair, and clearly understood" [S1]
Says taxing districts' budgets, not assessed values, set the amount of tax [S3]
